title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber III Cap. 18 De attributis Dei tertii generis densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber III Cap. 18 De attributis Dei tertii generis COMPLETE (PHYS 676–mid-720 before Cap. 19).
